purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Kerala has an official Bhu-Naksha/e-Maps cadastral viewer and Ente Bhoomi land-information portal, while the Directorate of Survey and Land Records explicitly lists Palakkad survey and digitization offices. Direct certificate failures and login gating prevented verification of a safe anonymous parcel geometry response; no sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local/state registry custody is evidenced by the Directorate of Survey and Land Records Palakkad office listings and the state cadastral viewer. Government of India DILRMP separately evidences Palakkad cadastral-map digitization reporting. None was verified as an open city-bound vector service.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Kerala Land Records Modernization Mission / Directorate of Survey and Land Records, Government of Kerala
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bhu-Naksha page found by discovery; page description exposes area-of-interest, resurvey sketch and block/survey/subdivision search concepts. Direct TLS-verified GET failed because the certificate was expired; no bypass used.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Government of Kerala, Revenue/Survey/Registration integrated portal
officialPrimarySources.observation: HTTP 200 official Malayalam landing page. It advertises real-time land parcel maps and says access is through single-sign-on login. No login or property query was attempted.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Directorate of Survey and Land Records, Government of Kerala
officialPrimarySources.observation: HTTP 200 official page lists Palakkad Survey Deputy Director, Assistant Director Re-Survey, District Survey Superintendent, Re-Survey Superintendent and District Digitization Centre offices.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
officialPrimarySources.observation: First-party web inspection identifies Palakkad district and tehsil-level cadastral-map digitization fields. Direct curl was stopped by TLS issuer verification failure; no exception used.

geometryDecision.details: No safe full parcel polygon and no verified stable native parcel identity were obtained. No exact-point hit or miss was used to infer coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kerala Bhu-Naksha/e-Maps, Ente Bhoomi, Palakkad Directorate survey offices and Government of India DILRMP reporting.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service documentation, local/state custody and a login-gated parcel-map portal; no anonymous parcel geometry, schema, CRS or citywide extent.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identifier
remainingUncertainty: The Bhu-Naksha service may expose machine-readable geometry after its certificate is repaired, and coverage may vary by village/taluk; neither was tested through an unsafe bypass.
